'''Kilmaulsi''' was the [[Language/Legends|language]] used by the [[Sentience/Legends|sentience]] [[Kilmaulsi]] [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Kilmauls system/Legends|Kilmauls system]]. The language had both spoken and written components. During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Hrakian]] [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] [[Hathox Greb]] was able to speak the Kilmaulsi language.<ref name="Outer Rim Worlds" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kilmaulsi was mentioned in ''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]'', a supliment for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' published by [[ Wizards of the Coast]]<ref name="Outer Rim Worlds" /> in [[March]] [[2004]].<ref name="Outer Rim Worlds Date">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=products/swrpgacc/888870000|text=Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds}}</ref>
